turns.t: Morning. Er, I'd like a sexual health check, please. I've just ended a relationship and I want to be sure.
Of course, and it's completely routine. Is there anything that prompted it, any symptoms?
Not really. A tiny bit of itching, down there, on and off, for about a fortnight. Nothing else.
Any discharge, sores, or pain when passing urine? ~
No. Just the itch. ~
Anything else medically I should know about?
I get eczema, mostly on my hands. That's all.
Let me check your pulse and temperature first. ~
Right. ~
Pulse 68, temperature 36.5.
Fine? ~
Fine. I'll examine you if you're comfortable, and there's a chaperone available if you'd prefer one. ~
No, it's fine. Go ahead.
Thank you. I can't see any sores, rash, or warts, and nothing else of concern.
That's a relief. ~
The itch may well be a minor irritation, but we'll check properly. What would you like to know about how this works? ~
Which tests do you do? ~
I'd like to take swabs for chlamydia and gonorrhoea, and arrange a urine sample, and a blood test for HIV, syphilis and hepatitis.
All of those? ~
It's the standard full screen. The swabs take a minute, and the blood is a single sample. ~
Okay. When will I know? ~
Results come back by text within a week, and if anything's positive, we'll phone you. ~
And if it's all clear? ~
You'll get a text saying so. And I'd like you to come back in two weeks, to make sure the itch has settled.
Two weeks. Fine. ~
Use condoms with any new partner until you've had the results, and ideally for a while after.
I will. ~
Anything else you'd like to ask, now you're here? ~
No, I think that's everything. Thanks for not making it awkward. ~
It's what we're here for. ~
